title: The Discount That Eats Your Profit
hook: That discount might be eating your profit.
script: That discount might be eating your profit. A customer asks for a price cut. You agree to keep the sale. But your supplier cost, packaging, delivery, and payment fees haven't changed. By the time you subtract everything, there may be nothing left. Here's a simple rule: calculate your full cost and your lowest profitable selling price before offering any discount. If the price falls below that line, change the offer instead. More sales are useless when every extra order loses money.
